description_paragraphs: A predictable action set $\mathcal{A}_t\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ is revealed each round. Contexts may depend on the past transcript. The parameter $\theta_\star$ is fixed and unknown.

Noise is conditionally $\sigma$-sub-Gaussian given the pre-action history and current action. The privacy sensitivity argument additionally requires realized action-reward pairs to satisfy the following bounds almost surely:
source_fields.existence: Use the model's concrete compactness, continuity, unique-optimum, or controllability promises; add none implicitly.
source_fields.instance: Each round reveals a predictable action set $\mathcal A_t\subset\mathbb R^d$; contexts may depend on the past. The parameter $\theta_\star$ is fixed and unknown. $$\|a\|_2\le L\quad(a\in\mathcal A_t),\qquad \|\theta_\star\|_2\le S,\qquad |\langle a,\theta_\star\rangle|\le B.$$ $$Y_t=\langle a_t,\theta_\star\rangle+\eta_t,\qquad \mathbb E[\eta_t\mid\mathcal H_{t-1},a_t]=0.$$ Conditional on the pre-action history and current action, the noise is $\sigma$-sub-Gaussian. The boundedness conditions needed for privacy sensitivity also require the actual action-reward pair to satisfy $$\|(a_t,Y_t)\|_2\le\widetilde L\qquad\text{almost surely}.$$ almost surely.
source_fields.parameter_domain_description: B: $B\ge0$ (public); L: $L>0$ (public); S: $S\ge0$ (public); T: $T\in\mathbb N,\ T\ge1$ (public); d: $d\in\mathbb N,\ d\ge1$ (public); \delta_{\mathrm{conf}}: $0<\delta_{\mathrm{conf}}<1$ (public); \delta_{\mathrm{priv}}: $0\le\delta_{\mathrm{priv}}<1$ (public); \epsilon_{\mathrm{priv}}: $\epsilon_{\mathrm{priv}}>0$ (public); \sigma: $\sigma\ge0$ (public); \widetilde L: $\widetilde L\ge0$ (public)

structured_source_contract.actions: predictable per-round set A_t subset R^d, ||a||_2<=L
structured_source_contract.contexts: may depend on past transcript, revealed before current action
structured_source_contract.privacy_boundedness: ||(a_t,y_t)||_2<=L_tilde almost surely; bounded realized rewards, not just Gaussian noise
structured_source_contract.rewards: y_t=<a_t,theta_star>+eta_t, conditional sigma-sub-Gaussian zero-mean noise; |mean reward|<=B

source_fields.finiteness_conditions: Mean rewards have absolute value at most B, so 0<=R_T<=2BT. Privacy sensitivity is separately controlled by the joint action/reward norm bound.
source_fields.normalization: Use the cumulative quantity over T rounds without dividing by T. Preserve the displayed order of probability or expectation.

description_paragraphs: The learner first observes the current context and action set, then selects $a_t$ and receives only that action’s scalar reward. The released action transcript satisfies joint privacy. Rewards for other actions remain hidden.

The parameters $d,T,L,S,\sigma,B,\widetilde{L},\epsilon_{\mathrm{priv}},\delta_{\mathrm{priv}},\delta_{\mathrm{conf}}$ are public. Reward parameters and future information of the admissible environment remain hidden.

Received feedback may be stored and reused in computation. Unrevealed information cannot be requested from past rounds, and consumed random samples cannot receive additional queries. Current-round exceptions are limited to the explicitly supplied full-function access or same-sample two-point interface.

The released action record satisfies joint differential privacy; other rewards are hidden. Inputs $d,T,L,S,\sigma,B,\widetilde L,\epsilon_{\mathrm{priv}},\delta_{\mathrm{priv}},\delta_{\mathrm{conf}}$ are public. The reward parameter and future environmental information are unknown. Received feedback may be stored and reused computationally. No unrevealed historical information or extra queries to exhausted samples are available; any within-round full-function or common-sample access must be explicit.

components.description: $T$ sequential rounds, or $T$ rounds per task

There are $N=T$ reward observations. The implementation combines linear UCB with a tree mechanism protecting sufficient statistics. Internal matrix and privacy work does not create free reward queries. Initialization and exploration are charged. Information, arithmetic, communication, and memory remain separate resources; no optimal arithmetic or bit complexity is asserted.

description_paragraphs: Neighboring streams $\mathsf D,\mathsf D^{\prime}$ differ only in one user's context/reward pair. The protected output is every action except that user's current recommendation, received privately. For every measurable event $E$, require:
The privacy relaxation $\delta_{\mathrm{priv}}$ is distinct from the statistical failure probability $\delta_{\mathrm{conf}}$.
Causal policies satisfying $(\epsilon_{\mathrm{priv}},\delta_{\mathrm{priv}})$ joint differential privacy are admissible.

Private randomization is allowed, with the seed independent of the fixed instance and future external samples. Internal arithmetic, memory, linear spans, and iteration forms are unrestricted except for the stated computation, communication, privacy, and within-round interaction limits.
